item.title: Barriers strewn across the road and left behind, 16th November
item.description:
Ringway have left roadworks barriers hazardously all over the road including road closed signs at the junction with hyde lane (which unsurprisingly have since been hit by a vehicle). The road is not shut and no works have been undertaken to the heavily degraded road surface. These barriers make travelling down the lane even more difficult than the numerous potholes, cracks and subsidence already do.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Brockhampton Lane, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury

item.title: Dog fouling, 16th November
item.description:
There is dog foul constantly on the pavement on the far side of this picture (opposite Little Herbert’s bus stop). We walk down here to school and there is always dog poo. All different colours! This morning I watched many junior school and secondary school children step in it. Please can a dog poo bin be installed or signs put up?
